newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco central bank makes no injection at repo.
newsitem.headline: Morocco central bank makes no injection at repo.

text.p: Morocco's bank al-Maghrib (central bank) made no injection in the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Thursday.
The bank received bids totalling 3.635 billion dirhams and allocated 2.500 billion dirhams at seven percent interest rate.
The amount was equal to the 2.500 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the bank said.
It satisfied 68.78 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on November 7, 1996, he added.
